question: How is the side leaf-series arranged in relation to the middle-leaf series?
premises: The middle-leaf has a series arrangement.
The comparison yadvat establishes a parallel manner.
The correlative tathā applies that manner to the side.
inference: The side leaf-series is arranged in the same manner as the middle-leaf series.
uncertainties: The exact spatial configuration implied by tatir remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Just as there is a series for the middle leaf, so there is a series of leaves on the side.
